entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order, press 1. For technical support, press 2. To speak with a representative, press 0 or stay on the line.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I have an order. I think I need to do a return? The website was very confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Michael Chen. Order number is... uh... VF789012.

Thank you, Michael. I see your order for the Pro-Series jersey, delivered on December 13th. Just to be sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
Oh, it's just... it's the wrong size. I ordered a medium like I always do, but this jersey is just way too tight. I don't understand.
Okay, so the fit isn't right. I understand completely. Are you looking to return it for a refund, or would you prefer an exchange for a different size?
I think I need an exchange for a large, but I couldn't figure out how to do it online. It's all so complicated. Can't you just help me?

Of course, Michael. It's no problem at all. Let me just check the policy for you... Okay, yes. I see you received the item only six days ago, and our return policy allows for up to 90 days for standard apparel items. So you are well within the timeframe.
Oh, 90 days? That's a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it. Thank you.

You're very welcome. I am processing the exchange now. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account. Just print that out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. As soon as we see it's in transit, we'll ship out the size large for you.
That's perfect. That's so much easier. Thank you so much, Sarah.
It's my pleasure, Michael. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again.
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
